test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I did not _____ to university yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e. go.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The verb form after "**did not**" should be the base form of the verb.
 
• "**Go**" is the base form of the verb "to go."
 
• "**Gone**" is the past participle form, which is incorrect in this context.
 
• "**Went**" is the past tense form, but it is incorrect after "did not."
 
• "**Going**" is the present participle form, which is also incorrect in this context.

Hence, the correct answer is option 2.
